name: Do I need to be present during the insurance adjuster's inspection?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to be present during the insurance adjuster's inspection?

acceptedAnswer.text: While not always mandatory, it is highly recommended that you or your chosen roofing contractor, like Discounted Roofing Co., be present during the insurance adjuster's inspection. Having a knowledgeable roofing professional on-site ensures that all damage is identified and discussed directly with the adjuster. Our team can point out issues that might otherwise be overlooked, facilitating a more thorough and accurate assessment for your claim.
